The study should be closed at this RAN3 meeting. In light of this, we are going to highlight the basic conclusions that can be drawn from the study item. First of all, the high-level principles constitute the guidelines and the benchmark on which normative work will be based. It stands to reason that the high-level principles shall remain valid during normative phase. Similarly, the work done in the use cases should be taken as baseline for the normative phase. We propose that RAN3 agrees to the above conclusions.
